title.narrative: Improvement of Territorial Public Investment Management
Mejoramiento de la Gestin de la Inversin Pblica Territorial

description.narrative: El objetivo de la operacin es apoyar a la Repblica de Per en sus esfuerzos por elevar el desarrollo socioeconmico territorial a travs de la mejora de la eficacia, eficiencia y efectividad en la gestin de la inversin pblica subnacional, principalmente en los gobiernos regionales, como articuladores del desarrollo en su territorio.

The operation's objective is to support the Republic of Peru in its efforts to increase socioeconomic development at the regional level, through an improvement in efficacy, efficiency and effectiveness in subnational public investment management, mainly in regional governments as coordinators of development in their territories.
Commitment in 2012-02-22
Disbursement in first quarter of 2013
Disbursement in first quarter of 2015
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2015
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2016
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2017
Disbursement in third quarter of 2014
